edited: apps/hub/src/app/courses/[course]/revision-notes/notes-index.tsx — the RD-pattern index gains the MathsGenie toolbar: (1) SEARCH BAR 'Search topics or notes...' with magnifier + clear button — client-side filter over sub-topic and note titles; a sub-topic whose own title matches shows ALL its notes (context), otherwise only title-matching notes; topic and row counts rescale per scope; matching multi-note rows force open (native details open={searching||active}); honest 'No notes match …' card; transient query (no URL state, no server contact); (2) RESUME BUTTON — play glyph (lucide Play fill-current opacity-60, the example's icon) + 'Resume {note title}' truncating at max-w-[13rem] exactly like the example, pointing at the most recently read note of THIS course (max notesRead.at; markNoteRead stamps on every note visit; course-scoped storage key) — hidden while nothing is read (the example's empty:hidden law); our tokens: rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-muted; (3) THE TICK — the MathsGenie done-tick as ReadTick: green filled check circle (svg circle + white check path, text-green-600 dark:text-green-500 — the corpus's existing green usage class) when read, faint outline circle (border-2 border-muted-foreground/25, the same hollow glyph the sidebar topic rows use) when not; role=img aria-label Read/Unread names BOTH states (UX audit 2026-10-02 #16 law); it replaces the old read dot on nested and loose note rows, and replaces the ProgressRing on SINGLE-note sub-topic rows (a one-note row's ring is binary — the tick is the note-level truth; the MathsGenie anatomy: one truth per row); MULTI-note rows keep the ProgressRing (partial progress across notes+questions+flashcards stays meaningful) with per-note ticks inside the expanded list

interpretation: 'Fully read' = the learner overlay's notesRead entry (markNoteRead on note visit) — the overlay records no scroll-depth fact, so read-presence is the honest signal; the helpful flag is NOT required for the tick. The single-note-row ring→tick swap is the one regression of information (a 1-note sub-topic carrying questions/flashcards loses its partial ring on this index) — disclosed, sidebar keeps full ring semantics, reversible. Search is title-only (sub-topic + note titles; spec codes and body text not indexed — disclosed); the query is deliberately transient (no URL param) because it is a scan aid, not a shareable view — deep links stay ?subtopic=/?spec=. Resume = last note OPENED (not 'first unread') — the example's semantic is 'Resume {last topic}', ours mirrors it; a 'continue with first unread' variant would be a different product decision, not bundled. The toolbar lives inside the client NotesIndex (progress + filter are learner-overlay facts) — the page.tsx of record is unchanged. Deviation from the example's button chrome: border (our stroke weight) not border-2, rounded-lg not rounded-xl — token parity beats pixel parity.
